reviews.text:
It is a beautiful-looking mosque, but unfortunately, it does not function properly as a place of worship. The mosque is kept locked during the day, and even when you knock, no one responds or opens the door.
We drove half an hour to get here, relying on the posted Mosque hours that stated it was open, only to find it completely locked. Because of this, we were forced to pray outside and make wudu using a bottle of water.
While the architecture is lovely, what is the point of having such a beautiful mosque built if people cannot even enter to pray? Very disappointing management.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Arif, I understand your frustrations and disappointment, but for security purposes we can’t leave the doors unlocked 24/7. We’ve had many threats and were also victim to arson in 2019. The doors are open a good amount of time during the day, especially during prayer hours the doors are unlocked, but in case they’re not, you just need to give our number a call so we could open the doors. The imam is always there as he lives there, so with a quick call he comes down to open the doors. I hope next time you have a better experience.

reviews.text: NICC is much more than a mosque — it is a welcoming and vibrant community center that truly serves people of all ages. The masjid provides a warm environment for worship, education, and community engagement. From daily prayers and khutbahs to Sunday School, youth activities, and family programs, there is a strong emphasis on building both faith and community. The leadership and volunteers work hard to create a space where everyone feels included, whether they are long-time members or first-time visitors. NICC has also become an important resource for outreach, interfaith engagement, and supporting families in times of need. A wonderful place to pray, learn, and connect.
